normalization: replace V1/V2/V3/V4 tokens and source-format names in validation prose with blind code
preserve authored source syntax and filenames because reviewability is being measured
omit timestamps, durations, model/session ids, dependency data, implementation paths, LOC, and other reviewer output
sort semantic facts by canonical fact bytes; preserve source diff hunk order
subjective_score_effect: descriptive_only; never changes correctness, authoring_task_errors, complexity vector, eligibility, dominance, or disposition
mapping_access: comparator only; reviewer receives blind code but not this mapping
